story_title: Behind the Scenes of a Video Channel
task_instruction: Rewrite each sentence in the opposite voice: change active sentences to passive and passive sentences to active.
paragraphs: Maya runs a video channel about practical science projects. She plans each episode with her small production team. {{red:Maya researches each topic before filming.}} {{mask_1}} {{red:The camera batteries are charged by her assistant the night before a shoot.}} {{mask_2}} {{red:Her editor is checking the sound levels now.}} {{mask_3}} {{red:The episode outline was written by Maya last weekend.}} {{mask_4}}

On filming day, the team sets up lights and microphones in a quiet room. {{red:Maya records the introduction beside the worktable.}} {{mask_5}} {{red:The demonstration materials have been arranged by the production assistant.}} {{mask_6}} {{red:A second camera captures close-up shots of the experiment.}} {{mask_7}} {{red:The room is being prepared by the team for the next scene.}} {{mask_8}}

After filming, Maya and her editor review the footage together. {{red:The editor has removed several long pauses from the video.}} {{mask_9}} {{red:Maya writes captions for viewers who prefer to read along.}} {{mask_10}} {{red:The final music track was selected by the team.}} {{mask_11}} {{red:A designer is creating a clear thumbnail for the episode.}} {{mask_12}}

The team checks the finished episode before publishing it. {{red:The video will be uploaded by Maya on Friday.}} {{mask_13}} {{red:The subtitles are reviewed by a volunteer before publication.}} {{mask_14}} {{red:Viewers can suggest future topics in the comments.}} {{mask_15}} {{red:The publication time has been changed by Maya.}} {{mask_16}}

After the episode goes live, Maya reads comments and plans the next project. {{red:Her assistant answers common questions about the materials.}} {{mask_17}} {{red:The most useful viewer suggestions are saved by Maya for future episodes.}} {{mask_18}} {{red:The team will discuss the next video idea at its meeting.}} {{mask_19}} {{red:A short behind-the-scenes clip was posted by the editor yesterday.}} {{mask_20}} Maya thanks her viewers and reminds them to follow safety instructions when trying projects at home.
